I'm passionate about using analytics to understand business performance, uncover insights, and help organizations make smarter decisions.

<p class="eyebrow">01 — BACKGROUND</p>

## Professional Background

Currently, I'm pursuing my master's in Applied Business Analytics at Boston University. Previously, I worked in project management at SDU University in Kazakhstan, coordinating teams, managing documentation, and supporting process improvements. These experiences shaped my interest in how data and strategy come together to create meaningful business outcomes.

<p class="eyebrow">02 — MY APPROACH</p>

## Turning Questions Into Insights

What interests me most about analytics is the connection between numbers and real business questions. I enjoy exploring a problem, identifying patterns, and figuring out what the results can tell us.

For me, analysis becomes valuable when it explains what is happening, why it matters, and what could be done next.

My project management experience has shaped how I approach analytical work. I value structure, attention to detail, and clear communication while keeping the bigger business objective in mind.

<p class="eyebrow">03 — BEYOND THE NUMBERS</p>

## Curious About the World, Too

My curiosity extends beyond data and business. I love exploring new cities, discovering local cafés, noticing interesting architecture, and experiencing different cultures. Traveling gives me a chance to step outside my usual routine and see familiar things from a different perspective.

My curiosity about the world has helped broaden my horizons and inspired my journey into international education and career development.
